item.description: Plenty of good economic news this week, with an outsize gain in jobs, especially private sector jobs. And a much lower-than-expected report on consumer prices

item.title: American Girl’s ‘modern era’ makeover of beloved dolls draws swift backlash from loyal fans
item.description: American Girl's redesigned historical dolls spark fierce backlash from longtime fans who say the modern makeover "ruins the whole point" of the beloved toys.

item.title: Trump’s newest voice at the Fed has advice for Kevin Warsh before he takes the helm
item.description: New Fed governor Stephen Miran signals shift from data-dependent monetary policy as Kevin Warsh's nomination stalls amid political turmoil at the central bank.

item.title: Tech titans Elon Musk and Reid Hoffman attack each other over latest Epstein emails
item.description: Elon Musk and LinkedIn co-founder Reid Hoffman clash on social media over alleged Jeffrey Epstein connections, trading accusations and email screenshots.

item.title: Living alone? The 'singles tax' that costs $10K a year
item.description: Living alone costs Americans over $10,000 extra per year in what experts call a "singles tax," as apartment rents surge nationwide, new data reveals.

item.title: Musk company chosen for underground transit system for Universal parks
item.description: Elon Musk’s Boring Company was chosen to enter negotiations for a proposed underground transit system connecting Universal Orlando parks and Epic Universe.

item.title: Verizon customers face 35-day wait to unlock paid-off phones under policy change
item.description: Verizon customers can avoid 35-day device unlock delays by paying off phones in-store with cash, chip cards, or contactless payments like Apple Pay instead of online methods.

item.title: Costco launches mobile app ordering for custom cakes and deli trays, easing customer woes
item.description: Costco is launching a new app feature that would end a "clunky" process many customers previously expressed frustrations over when shopping at the warehouse.

item.title: Baby food recalled nationwide after dangerous toxin found in federal testing raises health concerns
item.description: Baby food recall alert: Initiative Foods recalls "Tippy Toes" apple pear banana fruit purée due to patulin toxin. Check products with BB 07/17/2026 date.

item.title: Award-winning pilot and wife die in plane crash after dirty windows prompt emergency landing, pet dog survives
item.description: Award-winning pilot declares emergency "due to oil on windshield" before fatal Texas crash. Ron and Barbara Timmermans died when aircraft hit power lines.
